Behind YMG Events

A love of bringing
a night to life.

I’m Dante, based in Genova. I enjoy creating occasions that give people a reason to come out, connect and have a great time. YMG Events is where I’m developing a more refined expression of that energy.

The direction is deliberate: thoughtful hospitality and a more mature crowd, with the music, personality and momentum of a proper night out.
